method: Corpus Corporum clean text (idno 7170, section 7170:1), cross-checked against the Latin Wikisource raw page, then collated word for word against the 1845 Migne PL 24 scan.
rights: Public domain in the USA. Outside the U.S., check local copyright rules.
scope: Prologue only (PL 24, columns 17-22). Liber I and the rest of the commentary are not hosted. The editor's preface and the Maurist/Martianay footnotes printed on these pages are omitted.

collation.witness: Internet Archive item PatrologiaLatina, file Patrologia Latina Vol. 24.pdf
notes: The collection catalog and the printed title page both give Paris, 1845 (Patrologiae tomus XXIV, S. Hieronymi tomus quartus).
Ligatures (sanctae, praesentia, and the rest) were expanded to ae, as in Corpus Corporum and Wikisource.
French typographic spaces before colons, semicolons, and question marks were normalized to ordinary spacing, as in Corpus Corporum and Wikisource.
In-text scripture citations are kept as printed, including Matth. VII, 76 and II Cor. I, 24.
No English translation is hosted: none published before 1931 is known.
collation.checks: Compared word for word with the 1845 Migne scan of Patrologia Latina volume 24, columns 17-22 (Internet Archive item PatrologiaLatina, PDF pages 13-15): 100% agreement; no wording differences were found. Ligatures were expanded and punctuation spacing was normalized. The editor's footnotes were omitted.

title: Commentariorum in Isaiam prophetam Prologus (Migne, Patrologia Latina 24, 1845)
